comment: The ldct-io release the manuscript cites. v0.1.0 was archived before the adversarial arm, the dose-decision analysis and the site-sensitivity analysis existed, so citing it would point a reader at code that cannot produce Sections 3.6.1, 3.6.2 and 3.7. version_doi stays null until 0.2.0 is tagged and archived, and build_manuscript.py --submission refuses to render while it is null. Same discipline as release.json; see docs/RELEASE.md.
